title: Rat Game
description:
OVERVIEW 📙• Asymmetrical online co-op with 1 Chef vs 2 to 7 Rats

• Play against a human or robot-controlled Chef

• Interconnected map filled with tasks & secrets

• Around 3 hours of playtime

OH, RATS!!!!!!!!!🐀Chef has been trying to exterminate the rats, leaving them no choice but to ruin his restaurant. Crawl through hidden shortcuts and hide in dark corners in a vast human-scale map. Work in teams of 2-8 to nibble through wires, clog the toilet, hack the PC – anything to get this place shut down for good!

YOU’RE COOKED!!!!!!👨‍🍳Rats are destroying your treasured family restaurant. Stomp around listening for the tell-tale sound of scrabbling claws, waiting for the right moment to grab them and throw them in the cage. If all else fails, you also have a gun. Time for some pest control!

DEFEAT THE ROBO-CHEF!!!! 🤖Co-op only mode sets you and your rat friends against the mighty mechanical Robo-Chef. He’s programmed to cook, clean… and to kill!

Rat Game is an asymmetrical comedy horror with a dynamic soundtrack, an interconnected map, squeaky proximity chat, and plenty of cheese. Last one standing wins.
description_short: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.
